format.encoding: ASCII; LF terminated; exactly one key=value per nonempty line; keys may be permuted; no comments, whitespace, escaping, include, environment or NSS
format.uid_gid: canonical decimal 0..4294967294; no leading zeros except 0, sign, boolean, float or whitespace; explicit same UID/GID roles allowed
format.unit: ASCII alphanumeric or @_.:-, at most128 bytes, nonempty .service stem; exact unit, no pattern
format.cgroup: absolute ASCII path at most512 bytes; nonempty components at most128 bytes; alphanumeric or @_.:-; no . or .. components; final component equals configured unit
format.elf_sha256: exactly64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; hash of live executable must match this configured pin
format.principal_id: 1..64 ASCII bytes, starts alphanumeric, remaining alphanumeric or _.-; Control and Agent tags must differ; no TaskFlow, PageOwner or capability grant

custody.namespaces: actual /proc/thread-self/ns/user,mnt,time dev/inode before and after; selected local namespaces only, not host production root
custody.observed_change: irreversibly retires this shared loaded source; byte/path/namespace restore cannot revive it
custody.fork: creator PID before state/atomic/alias inspection and callbacks; child Drop only closes its descriptor copies; no shutdown, unlock, unlink or inherited channel synchronization

deadline.action_and_report: same minimum original ceilings; no renewed duration budget or accepted capture in approved route
deadline.late_return: typed refusal after original ceiling; synchronous filesystem/procfs syscalls are not preemptively interrupted
